titleText: iGaming worker accused of rape on St Julian's beach
mainText: From Times of Malta: iGaming worker accused of rape on St Julian's beach. Police say this is the second claim against the man and urge any other victims to come forward

titleText: Registered full-time employment up 5% in 12 months – NSO
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Registered full-time employment up 5% in 12 months – NSO. Registered full-time employment has totalled to 312,504 people in the workforce in June 2026, the National Statistics Office said. Comparing this to recorded figures from June 2025, registered full-time employment is up 5.0% year-on-year, NSO Malta said.

titleText: Repeat offender jailed for 135 days over vehicle theft and driving without licence and insurance
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Repeat offender jailed for 135 days over vehicle theft and driving without licence and insurance. Adnan Alabdula Mohamad, a 21-year-old Syrian national residing in Siġġiewi, was sentenced to 135 days in prison on Monday after admitting to vehicle theft and driving-related offences. The offences took place on 21 October in Qormi.

titleText: Momentum urges public to object to seven-storey Mosta elderly care home
mainText: From MaltaToday: Momentum urges public to object to seven-storey Mosta elderly care home. Momentum has urged the public to submit formal objections to a proposed seven-storey elderly care home in Mosta before the 11 December deadline.
